outcome: successful management of viable Caesarean Scar Ectopic Pregnancy (CSP)
cohort: The study describes a single case of a patient with a viable Caesarean Scar Ectopic Pregnancy (CSP).
finding: A viable Caesarean Scar Ectopic Pregnancy (CSP) was successfully managed using a combination of systemic Methotrexate and subsequent suction and evacuation.
mod_finding: The frequency of Caesarean Scar Ectopic Pregnancy (CSP) is increasing with the global rise in caesarean sections, indicating a link between this mode of birth and the condition.
